name: letmespam
description: Two modes: normal sends instantly; say the start word for spam mode, batch freely (every line echoed in full), then say the send word to optimize with a model of your choice and send.

preamble.title: Optimizer instruction
preamble.description: System prompt for the optimizer model. Empty = built-in.

optimizer.title: Optimizer model
optimizer.description: off, an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable — always the newest of that family), session, or a full model id.

enterWord.title: Start word
enterWord.description: Type alone on a line to enter spam mode.

sendWord.title: Send word
sendWord.description: Type alone on a line to send the batch.

cancelWord.title: Discard word
cancelWord.description: Type alone on a line to discard the batch.

effort.title: Optimizer effort
effort.description: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.
